items.text: I will be presenting a poster on [MV-IVF](#mv-ivf), a native inverted-file indexing approach for multi-vector retrieval, at the [VecDB 2026 workshop](https://vecdb-ws.github.io/vldb2026/papers.html) in Boston.
The [UFO Trees paper](#ufo-trees) was selected as a Best Paper Nominee at PPoPP 2026.
I will be co-presenting a tutorial on parallel clustering at SPAA in Portland.
I will be giving a talk on [Optimal Parallel Algorithms for Single-Linkage Clustering](#parsld) at the [Brown Theory Seminar](https://theoryseminar.cs.brown.edu/Spring2025.html).
I will be attending the [3rd AlgoPARC workshop on Parallel Algorithms and Data Structures](https://algoparc.ics.hawaii.edu/workshop/2025/index.html) at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa.
I will be attending the [ICERM workshop on Fusing Theory and Practice of Graph Algorithms](https://icerm.brown.edu/program/hot_topics_workshop/htw-25-ftpga#section-2) at Brown University.
I will be attending the [DIMACS tutorial on fine-grained complexity](https://dimacs.rutgers.edu/dimacsevents/workshop-details/dimacs-tutorial-on-fine-grained-complexity).

I will be attending the [DIMACS workshop on Efficient Algorithms for High Dimensional Metrics](https://dimacs.rutgers.edu/dimacsevents/workshop-details/dimacs-workshop-on-efficient-algorithms-for-high-d).
I will be presenting our work on k-median at the [Capital Area Theory Seminar](https://cats.cs.umd.edu/fall23.html), UMD.
